tools.name: search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search the user's professional network by name, company, school, role or free text. Returns matching people with how close the relationship is.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get one contact
tools.description: Everything Orbit knows about one person, including recent interactions. Use search_contacts first to find their id.

tools.name: who_do_i_know_at
tools.title: Who do I know at a company
tools.description: The people in the user's network at a given company or organisation — the warm path in.

tools.name: due_followups
tools.title: Who to follow up with
tools.description: People the user owes a follow-up, or whose relationship is going cold.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.title: List reminders
tools.description: The user's reminders and to-dos: what is due today, what is coming up, what has no date, and what is already done. Use due_followups instead for people going cold.

query.description: Match the title or contact name.

tools.name: get_network_overview
tools.title: Network overview
tools.description: How big the user's network is and how it is doing right now: totals, inner circle, recent activity, what is overdue. Good for a weekly review or a first question.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.title: One person's history
tools.description: The dated history with one person — meetings, calls, notes and messages, newest first — and a total for the range. Use it for when they last spoke, how often they meet, or what happened over a period; narrow with since/until (YYYY-MM-DD). get_contact returns only the handful most recent.

since.description: Only entries on or after this day.

until.description: Only entries on or before this day.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.title: What the user is working towards
tools.description: The user's active networking goals, in their own words. Use it when a question is open-ended — who to reconnect with, who matters right now, what to say — so the answer serves what they are actually trying to do.

tools.name: find_path_to
tools.title: Find a way in
tools.description: Who in the user's network could open a door to a company, a school or a person, ranked by how well the user actually knows them. Give an organisation ("Stripe") or a person's name. If that person is already in the network it says so, because then there is no path to find.

target.description: A company, a school, or a person's name.

tools.name: log_interaction
tools.title: Log an interaction
tools.description: Record that the user talked to someone — a meeting, a call, an email or a message.

tools.name: request_send
tools.title: Write an email for the user to send
tools.description: Draft an email and put it in front of the user for approval. THIS DOES NOT SEND ANYTHING. The user reads the recipient and the message in Orbit and decides; tell them the draft is waiting rather than implying it has gone out.

contactId.description: The Orbit contact this is for, when there is one.

clientName.description: Your product's name, shown to the user on the approval card.

tools.name: get_send_status
tools.title: Check a draft
tools.description: Whether a draft from request_send is still waiting, was sent, or was turned down.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change what Orbit knows about someone — their role, company, location, how the user met them, or the notes on their profile.

tools.name: add_note
tools.title: Add a note about someone
tools.description: Append a dated note to a person's timeline — something the user learned, said or wants to remember. Use log_interaction instead when they actually spoke.

externalId.description: Pass a stable id to make a retry idempotent.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.title: Create a reminder
tools.description: Add a to-do, optionally about a person and optionally with a due date. Undated reminders live in Anytime.

dueDate.description: ISO timestamp. Omit for no date.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.title: Complete a reminder
tools.description: Mark a reminder done. Find its id with list_reminders.

tools.name: snooze_reminder
tools.title: Snooze a reminder
tools.description: Push a reminder out by a number of days, from today.

tools.name: schedule_follow_up
tools.title: Schedule a follow-up
tools.description: Put someone back on the user's calendar in a number of days. Reuses their pending reminder if they already have one, rather than creating a second.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.title: Add a contact
tools.description: Add someone new to the user's network. Checks for an existing match first and refuses rather than creating a duplicate unless force is set.
